label: Thermal gradients
description: Hot coral folds into amber and a quiet violet edge.
technique: Layered radial and linear CSS gradients.
limits: A color study, not a temperature map or measured heat field.

label: 3D particles
description: A small constellation of softly shaded spheres.
technique: Twelve SVG spheres with radial shading; a 2D depth approximation.
limits: No 3D engine, camera, collision model or particle simulation.

label: Fluted glass
description: Warm color, seen through a rhythm of vertical ribs.
technique: Layered gradients and translucent repeating stripes.
limits: Illustrative ribbing; no optical refraction or glass simulation.

label: Persian rugs
description: An original Persian-inspired geometric textile study.
technique: An original repeating SVG diamond motif and framed border.
limits: An illustrative adaptation, not an authentic traditional pattern or documented regional reproduction.

label: ASCII pixels
description: Quiet character grids with a few solid pixels.
technique: Original monospaced SVG characters and square marks.
limits: Decorative characters carry no data, code or executable instruction.

label: Marbled paper
description: Mineral green and clay ribbons on warm paper.
limits: A vector interpretation of marbling, not a captured paper sample or fluid model.

label: CRT scanlines
description: Phosphor green, fine horizontal lines, soft edges.
technique: Static repeating lines, radial glow and an inset vignette.
limits: An illustrative display texture; no flicker or simulated refresh behavior.

label: Crushed velvet
description: Wine-colored folds with a soft, uneven sheen.
technique: Overlapping directional gradients and fine grain.
limits: A shaded illustration; no textile scan or material reflectance measurement.

label: Pressed flowers
description: Airy botanical silhouettes on an ivory field.
technique: Original SVG stems, leaves and translucent petals.
limits: Invented botanical forms; no species identification or herbarium reproduction.

label: Damaged film
description: Sepia grain, scratches and a still light leak.
technique: Original SVG scratches with gradients and grain.
limits: A static image treatment; no captured film, flicker or archival provenance.

label: Water ripples
description: Layered rings across a shallow blue-green field.
limits: A stylized wave pattern, not a water-surface or interference solver.

label: Wasp nest
description: Papery hexagonal cells in sand, bark and pale ochre.
technique: Original SVG hexagonal tiling with nested paper-like contours.
limits: An organic paper study, not a biological model or scanned nest.

label: Iridescent shapes
description: Pearlescent forms with cool and warm reflected color.
technique: Original SVG forms with linear and radial color shading.
limits: A 2D appearance study, not thin-film optical simulation or measured iridescence.

label: Foggy windows
description: Soft blue-green haze and suspended droplets.
technique: Muted gradients and original SVG droplet highlights.
limits: A synthetic frost/condensation illustration with no external scene or weather data.

label: Liquid metal
description: Silver bands shaped into a flowing, high-contrast surface.
technique: An original SVG shape with a multistop metallic gradient.
limits: A 2D reflective illustration, not a fluid or physically based metal renderer.
